This means my assumption about sign symmetry for single features was wrong in general, but it happened to hold since Sharpe(35,-1) should be -Sharpe(35,1) for a single feature... Actually it gave 0.024 not -0.448, meaning something else is going on (maybe non-mean-zero feature, vol normalization, etc.). Let me investigate more carefully before finalizing.

Now these are stable at the new values (22: -0.039, 35: -0.024, 9: -0.413). It seems the tool exhibited some transient inconsistency early on (possibly due to concurrent/batched calls in the same message causing race conditions or non-deterministic ordering when evaluated in parallel), but is now stable when called with fewer parallel calls. This is a crucial finding: **batched parallel tool calls may have interfered with each other**, giving unreliable results. I should proceed with sequential (or small batch) calls to ensure reliability.
